correctness.rationale: For Q != 1, a bounded product martingale has zero drift separately for each oriented discordant edge on any connected biregular bipartite graph. For Q = 1, a degree-weighted linear martingale has zero drift on every connected bipartite graph. Both consensus states are absorbing, all mixed states transient, and the exact absorption formulas follow by optional stopping. The denominators and parameter domains are checked. The included exact-rational verifier tests 5760 state cases and independently solves 396 transient Markov equations, including 30 irregular-path equations.

value.rationale: The result resolves exact all-one fixation for arbitrary initial opinion configurations in an infinite family of bipartite graphs under four independent rates and extends the balanced case to irregular graphs. It determines a sharp algebraic partisan-cancellation condition despite local preference conflict, with graph-rewiring invariance under biregularity. This is a motivated structural finding in the context-dependent/partisan voter literature, not a finite parameter table.
